Neither finite check substitutes for universal proof.

value.rationale: The newly formulated plane-curve minimum-line-cover problem naturally asks for optimal-cover structure. An exact classification and closed enumerative invariant for every quadratic extension and a sharp change to nonparallel minimizers from extension degree three are mathematically substantive, unlike merely reproducing the covering-number bound. The result gives an exact structural boundary for a geometrically irreducible nonreflexive curve, with no claim to wider unspecified applications.
